name: Olive Catherine Simons (Decker, Parsons)
milestones: Buried at Oak Hill Cemetery, Battle Creek, Michigan
sources: Ancestry.com, 1850 United States Federal Census (Coventry, Summit County, Ohio; NARA M432, roll 732, page 87b)
Ancestry.com, 1860 United States Federal Census (Richland, DeKalb County, Indiana; NARA M653, roll 254, page 242)
Ancestry.com, 1870 United States Federal Census (Northwest, Williams County, Ohio; NARA M593, roll 1282, page 145A)
Ancestry.com, public member tree "A miscellaneous research tree" (tree 62391298)
Find a Grave, memorial 78651501 (Henry Simons, Billingstown Cemetery)
Ancestry.com, Ohio, U.S., Wills and Probate Records (Williams County will records, vol. 5–6, 1889–1897): will of Henry Simons
notes: Child of Henry and Mary Simons; brother or sister of Aaron Simons. Born in Indiana; "Oliva", aged 3, in 1860 and Olive C., 12, in 1870. Find a Grave lists her as Olive Catherine Decker Parsons.
CORRECTION: born 28 Oct 1857 in DeKalb County, Indiana (Find a Grave; aged 3 in 1860); the Ancestry tree gives 1856.
Died 9 Apr 1932 at Battle Creek, Michigan. Married Peter Decker (1856–1924) in 1874; their sons were Simeon (1881–1949) and Clyde (1888–1981). In 1928 she married Stephen Parsons (1851–1931).
